title: Treatments for Depression
author: 67d0072af60ba37f8e4af780
chapter_outcomes: Understand the two mental health problems unipolar depression and addiction, including: the symptoms and features according to the International Classification of Diseases (ICD) of depression, addiction
Understand how the incidence of mental health problems changes over time
Understand how mental health problems affect individuals and society
Understand the influence of genes as an explanation, including strengths and weaknesses of each explanation: depression, addiction
Understand the use of cognitive theory as an explanation of depression, including strengths and weaknesses of the explanation
Understand the use of learning theory as an explanation of addiction, including strengths and weaknesses of the explanation
Understand the use of cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) as a treatment, including strengths and weaknesses of each therapy: depression, addiction
Understand the use of drugs as a treatment, including strengths and weaknesses of each treatment: depression, addiction

Understand the aims, procedures, and findings (results and conclusions), strengths and weaknesses of: Caspi et al. (2003) Influence of Life Stress on Depression: Moderation by a Polymorphism in the 5-HTT Gene

Understand the aims, procedures, and findings (results and conclusions), strengths and weaknesses of: Young (2007) Cognitive Behavior Therapy with Internet Addicts: Treatment Outcomes and Implications

Understand the nature and nurture debate, including: the term 'nature', the term 'nurture', the use of content, theories, and research drawn from psychological problems to explain the nature and nurture debate
